doc: REAL naked base damage from engine AttributeSystem (B2Probe v3). This is the ONLY authoritative per-level player damage for B1 monster-HP sizing. Naked = no weapon/armor; main-stat build (DK 50Str/30Vit/20Agi, DW 80Ene/20Vit, FE 70Agi/20Vit/10Str, etc.; solo 8 points/level). avgDmg = (baseMin+baseMax)/2 = per-hit vs monster defense 0; monster defense subtracts per legacy path. skillX2 = starter-skill hit (SkillMultiplier const = 2). These are BASE, pre-weapon.
units: damage points; monster HP target = avgDmg * desiredHits / hitChance
note_to_B1: Your hand-written monster HP curve used damage 2-4x HIGHER than these real values. Re-size monster HP = avgDmg(real) * desiredHits / hitChance. For the 4-8s starter target at L1 with 1 swing/s and hit~1.0: HP = avgDmg * 4..8. DK avgDmg=37 => starter grind mob HP ~150..300 (pre-solo); after solo x0.45 => ~70..135. This matches the current Beetle post-solo HP=112.

pvp_mirror_naked.note: naked PVP stays ~1.5-2 hits across levels because HP scales with Vit in step with damage; not a high-level oneshot blowup.
